cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.hint: A website that does not ask for a particular camera gets the first one in this list that is connected. Drag a camera to change the order.

microphones.title: Microphones
microphones.hint: A website that does not ask for a particular microphone gets the first one in this list that is connected. The system default is the microphone your system has chosen: one below it is only used when the system chooses it or a website asks for it.

devices.sort: Sort {name}: {position} of {total}. The up and down arrow keys move it.

profile.label: Profile
profile.hint: Each profile keeps its own choices.

unread.label: The permissions could not be read
unread.hint: What shows below may be out of date.

empty.label: No website has a choice of its own
empty.hint: A website that wants the camera, the microphone, your location or notifications asks first. What you answer shows here, to change or take back.

reset.popups: Back to blocked, as for every site
reset.label: Reset {permission} for {site}
